Owns connection/config, not every business responsibility.
Default constructor owns con; Connection constructor borrows.

draft, holdCode, holdExpiresAt and completed; synchronize per map.

One transaction: consume token + ownership FOR SHARE + valid placeholder INSERT
+ generated key + final LH UPDATE + graph readback + commit.
Generated unique activeSlotId stays in DB, not an entity setter.
Solid arrow: entity reference field association. Dashed: actual call / HTTP / forward.
UI boxes are JSP artifacts, not invented Java View fields.
Integer is java.lang.Integer; money is BigDecimal; Date is java.util.Date.
No standalone business helpers or intermediate packaging JSPs.
